title: rhombus-std config
description: The grammar for a package's "rhombus-std" marker (its value in package.json) and for a standalone rhombus-std config file it, or a peer, extends.

$schema.description: Points an editor at this schema. A standalone rhombus-std.json file carries it; a package.json marker never needs it.

extends.description: One path, or an array of paths (relative to the file that declares them), each to another rhombus-std-shaped file — JSON, YAML (.yaml/.yml), or TOML (.toml), chosen by the target's extension. An array applies left to right: each path's own resolved content deep-merges over everything accumulated from the paths before it, so a later path wins a leaf collision against an earlier one. The accumulated result of the whole "extends" list is this config's BASE — this config's own keys deep-merge OVER it and win every remaining leaf collision. Resolution is blind: a path that isn't a readable file contributes nothing, silently — the same whether this directive was written by hand or supplied by the workspace default. An extended file may itself carry "extends"; a chain may be arbitrarily long, and a cycle (a path already reached earlier in the chain) also contributes nothing rather than looping. The merge itself: an object recurses key-by-key, an array concatenates as base-then-winner with each element left atomic, and any other value replaces.

typefor.description: Controls how the typefor<T>() authoring primitive emits the runtime Type value it derives.

emit.description: "hoisted" lifts the derived Type to a shared module-level constant; "inline" writes it fresh at each call site.

inline.description: The type-driven sugar publish list: every entry names a member the inline stage substitutes at a consumer call site.

entries.description: The publish list, in declaration order.

entry.description: One publish-list entry, in one of four shapes distinguished by which fields are present.

instanceMemberEntry.description: An instance-member sugar entry: the interface member named by "type"/"member" is ambient, its body living on "impl"'s "member"-named property.

type.description: A "<package>:<Name>" reference to the interface the member is declared on.

impl.description: A "<package>:<Name>" reference to the export whose "member"-named property holds the body.

member.description: The member name shared by "type" and "impl".

ownBodyMemberEntry.description: An instance-member sugar entry whose own declaration is its body: the interface member named by "type"/"member" is not ambient, so there is no separate "impl" to hold it.

type.description: A "<package>:<Name>" reference to the interface the member is declared on.

staticMemberEntry.description: A static / namespace-const member sugar entry: "impl" is both the call-base anchor and the body holder.

impl.description: A "<package>:<Name>" reference to the value that is both the call-base anchor and the body holder.

floaterEntry.description: A free-standing sugar entry: "impl"'s own source is the body.

impl.description: A "<package>:<Name>" reference to the function whose own source is the body.
